notes.title: GRAVIT Performance Improvements
notes.content:
Optimised Medium quality settings to achieve a more stable 90 fps on Steam Deck OLED

It is recommended to choose Medium quality on Steam deck for best performance.

Minor menu and gameplay bug fixes

notes.title: GRAVIT Update
notes.content:
Fixed a movement bug when looking directly up/down

Fixed a bug with moving platforms

Adjusted the sound and pitch of certain sound effects

Minor level adjustments

Thanks for supporting GRAVIT! New levels are currently in development and will be released soon.

notes.title: Demo Build Update
notes.content:
Demo build of GRAVIT updated to resolve some minor bugs.

New level added to the demo.
